entry.content:
Summary Card: The Travel with Chance Team was at Love for Autism, presented by Ryker’s Foundation for Autism Awareness

Yesterday, the Travel with Chance team as at the Love for Autism event here in Wichita. We had an amazing time meeting families, providers, and talking with them about our services and how we can help the community. We look forward to seeing the community again at Plant-O-Ween in Kechi on October 10th!
